label: 设备销售
definition: Hiwave issuer-reported equipment sales across all served industries; business description identifies ultrasonic scanning microscopes, not a semiconductor-only or HBM-qualified equipment revenue series. Excludes separately reported technical services and accessories/other revenue.

label: 提供技术服务
definition: Hiwave source product-table technical services across served industries; not equipment revenue.

label: 配件及其他收入
definition: Hiwave source product-table accessories and other revenue basket retained to preserve sibling reporting boundary; not equipment-only revenue or a component-supplier expansion.

label: 研发费用
definition: Hiwave consolidated profit-analysis table R&D expense line, used for the printed relative change; distinct from total R&D investment.
